hero.sub: Konihaus installs and manages your Smart Home — platform-agnostic, local, without vendor lock-in. For seniors, renters, and vacation home owners in Switzerland.

intro.p1: Most smart home solutions lock you into a proprietary ecosystem: Google, Amazon, or Apple. Konihaus does it differently.
intro.p2: I install and manage your smart home openly, locally, and compatible with almost any device. Your data is processed locally, remote access for support is encrypted, and notifications are optional and may go through external services like Apple or Google.

intro.card2_b: I install everything and keep it running remotely.
intro.card3_b: Switch devices without rebuilding your system.

process.p: From consultation to ongoing management, I handle everything. No technical experience needed.
process.step1_b: We discuss your needs and what fits best. No sales pitch — just listening and honest recommendations.
process.step2_b: I install all devices, set up the platform, and configure all automations. 2-4 hours, no wall modifications.
process.step3_b: I show you and your family how everything works — simply, without jargon. Manuals in German and English.
process.step4_b: I monitor your system, perform updates, and am available for issues. Monthly report for you and your family.

about.name: Konrad 'Koni' Hefelle
about.p1: My name is Konrad — everyone calls me Koni. As a Solution Architect specializing in frontend technology, I make complex systems understandable and usable.
about.p2: Konihaus came from my own frustration: either you lock yourself into a proprietary ecosystem, or you struggle through alone as a tech expert. There was no professionally managed, local solution — until now.
about.quote: I want your home to work for you — not for Amazon or Google.

testimonials.t1_q: Finally I can check from Basel if my mother's heating in Zurich is working. Koni set everything up in three hours.
testimonials.t2_q: My vacation home in Zermatt was always a worry. Now I get an immediate message if something is wrong — water pipe, window, everything.
testimonials.t3_q: I thought smart homes weren't for me. Koni explained everything to me in an hour — without a single technical term.

faq.sub: The key points from our Terms & Conditions — explained briefly.
faq.q1: How long am I committed for?
faq.a1: If you replace the setup investment with a 2-year service agreement, the minimum term is 24 months. After that the contract continues indefinitely and either side can cancel with one month's notice, effective at the end of a month. If you pay the setup cost upfront, there is no minimum term.
faq.q2: How do I cancel, and what happens if I cancel early?
faq.a2: Cancel in writing or by email, with one month's notice effective at the end of a month. If you end the contract before the minimum term expires, you can either pay the waived setup investment pro rata and keep the hardware, or return the hardware within 14 days — in which case no payment is due.
faq.a3: Yes — once you've paid the setup investment in full, either upfront or through the 2-year service agreement. Until then it remains Konihaus's property, but stays installed and in use at your home.
faq.q4: What happens if a device fails or I want to swap it?
faq.a4: We pass manufacturer warranties on to you; beyond that we give no additional warranty on third-party hardware. Because we build on open standards (Zigbee, Z-Wave, Matter, WiFi), you can swap or add individual devices at any time without rebuilding the system.
faq.q5: What keeps working after the contract ends?
faq.a5: Remote access, support and updates from us stop when the contract ends. Your locally installed system — the Home Assistant hub and all devices — keeps running on its own as long as it belongs to you. On request, you'll get the access credentials and configuration documentation.
faq.a6: Any time — upgrading is very welcome. For every request I put together a new quote: a small addition is billed once, moving to a higher package raises the monthly fee. Existing equipment is almost always reused; only a bigger leap needs a new hub, and even then you only pay the difference. Costs depend on the scope — the current packages show the range. A new minimum term only applies for bigger changes like a new hub, not for adding a few devices.
